question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38b49736462e93c83ab28fa9295c5fb89cf92bcacc7453a759918b28cb136644.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Step I: The triangle is getting flipped to the next image and then shifted it's place in clockwise direction.

Step II: The arrow is getting rotated in clockwise direction in each next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95902cc580a2708141aed2f17107a0705ea11178ef2d3aadbeb4cb0a593abb4d.png] 

So, option 1 will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
